p_overtime_measured.quantity: season overtime rate (share of completed games decided in overtime)
p_overtime_measured.method: count of games with a recorded overtime in the captured official game log, divided by completed games; Wilson 95% CI is reported by the strategy-lab probability audit alongside this value
p_overtime_measured.why_not_the_model_approximation: the model's per-game normal approximation (p_overtime_approx) averages ~0.019 on this season against a realised 0.050; the strategy-lab probability audit rejects equality at p = 0.012 (exact), so the measured rate is the honest price for the column
p_overtime_measured.note: This is a measurement over committed official transcriptions, not a live fetch. Re-run the script to reproduce; re-transcribe the game pages to re-verify.
